info.name: Story Packages API

item.name: 📖 Story Packages
item.description:
Admin endpoints for managing story promotion packages. Each package defines a duration and price.

Base URL: {{baseUrl}}/admin/story-packages

Authentication: Bearer {{adminToken}} in Authorization header

request.description: Returns all story packages sorted by price ascending. Each package includes: id, description, durationHours, price, createdAt, updatedAt.

request.description:
Create a new story package.

Required fields:
- description: string (1-500 chars)
- durationHours: integer (must be 24, 48, or 72 — unique, no two packages with same duration)
- price: number (min 0)
